name: progress
summary: Shows accessible determinate or indeterminate task progress with visible task copy.

agent.useWhen: A task has measurable completion or an active wait with no reliable estimate.
agent.avoidWhen: The operation completes immediately or completion and failure need a final alert or recovery action.

invariants: The application owns task data and server-rendered updates; this component owns no command, route, polling, browser-side numeric state, or JavaScript lifecycle.
A visible nonblank label is required and is also the accessible name of the native progress element.
Determinate state requires finite value and maximum with maximum > 0 and 0 <= value <= maximum; values are rejected rather than clamped.
Indeterminate state is explicit and omits both value and maximum; suffix is only allowed for determinate state.
Optional detail and suffix are plain text and HTML-encoded. Tone selects info, success, warning, or danger; size selects regular or compact track height.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], [[progress]], [[suffix]], and [[detail]] slot; substitutions are single-pass so user text cannot inject slots.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-progress-detail-text
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls text color for supporting detail progress.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-progress-gap
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Controls spacing between elements for progress.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-progress-tone
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Runtime tone selection for progress; this selects component state rather than a theme color.
